title: Progressive Web App: manifest, installation and notifications

videos.script:
The planner works offline since the last lesson. One file more, and it can be installed: an icon on the home screen, a window of its own, no address bar. {{manifest}} That file is the manifest, and you will write it, draw the icons it names, and ask the browser itself whether the planner now qualifies. The first answer is no, with a reason, which is the useful kind of no.

{{button}} Then an install button of the planner's own, shown only when the browser says installing is possible.

{{notify}} And last, notifications: what a page needs to show one, the permission it has to ask for, and push, which lets a server reach a person whose page is closed. {{respect}} That is the most powerful thing in this course, and the easiest to abuse, so the lesson ends with when not to use it.
